body.heading: Find the beat
paragraphs: Say a rhyme you know, like Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. Clap once for every beat as you say it.
Notice how the words fit the claps like footsteps on a path.

body.heading: Stomp the rhymes
paragraphs: Say it again. This time, stomp softly on the rhyming words: star and are, high and sky.
Try clapping faster and slower. The rhyme still works, like a song played at different speeds.

takeaway: Rhymes have a beat you can feel in your hands and feet.
safetyNotes: Stomp gently, especially if people live below you.
